title: Norwegian Spicy Frittata
description: A twist on the classic frittata, this Norwegian-inspired dish combines spicy sausage with eggs and cheese for a bold breakfast option.

ingredients.name: Spicy sausage
ingredients.notes: Use Norwegian-inspired sausage for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.notes: Large eggs work best for frittatas

ingredients.name: Heavy cream
ingredients.notes: Adds richness and creaminess to the dish

ingredients.name: Grated cheddar cheese
ingredients.notes: Sharp cheddar works best for this recipe

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper is essential

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: Unsalted butter works best for this recipe

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Adds a pop of color and freshness to the dish

instructions: Sauté the spicy sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the cooked sausage from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the butter and let it melt over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and cook until the edges start to set, about 3-4 minutes.
Sprinkle the grated cheese over the top of the eggs and transfer the skillet to the preheated oven.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley (if using).
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve immediately.
Serve with toasted bread or hash browns for a hearty breakfast option.
